text.tspan: Hardened defaults on every service (YAML anchor)
read_only root filesystem, tmpfs for /tmpcap_drop: [ALL], no-new-privilegesmemory and CPU limitsdistroless
static image, non-root uid 65532healthcheck = the binary's own healthcheck subcommand (no shell, no curl)
